what_to_detect: A trigger whose condition requires its source to be harnessed is evaluated with the source harnessed, and fires.
near_miss: The same kind of trigger evaluated while its source is not harnessed (never harnessed, or a new object since), and not fired.

what_to_detect: A trigger whose condition requires its source to be harnessed is evaluated while the source, harnessed on an earlier turn, has stayed on the battlefield, and fires.
near_miss: The same kind of trigger evaluated while its source is not harnessed (never harnessed, or a new object since), and not fired.
